definitions.explanation: A message delivered orally through another person, rather than in writing. Used when asking someone to relay a message to a third party.

examples.japanese: {伝言|でんごん}をお{願|ねが}いできますか。
{彼|かれ}に{伝言|でんごん}を{伝|つた}えてください。
examples.english: Please pass the message to him.

examples.japanese: {伝言|でんごん}ゲームで{話|はなし}が{変|か}わってしまった。
examples.english: The story changed in the game of telephone.
examples.notes: 伝言ゲーム = telephone game (party game)

notes:
USAGE: {伝言|でんごん} refers to spoken messages relayed through an intermediary. It's commonly used in phone conversations and business settings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{伝言|でんごん}を{頼|たの}む (to ask someone to relay a message)
・{伝言|でんごん}を{残|のこ}す (to leave a message)
・{伝言|でんごん}を{伝|つた}える (to pass on a message)
・{伝言|でんごん}をお{願|ねが}いします (may I leave a message?)

RELATED WORDS:
・{伝言|でんごん}ゲーム (telephone game - party game)
・{伝言板|でんごんばん} (message board)
・{伝言|でんごん}メモ (message memo)
・メッセージ (message - loanword)
・{連絡|れんらく} (contact, communication)

PHONE USAGE: When calling and the person isn't available, you can say 「{伝言|でんごん}をお{願|ねが}いできますか」 to leave a message.
